lines: The cistern is dry. Haul from a creek (risky water), or put someone on water duty.
It arches its back to the sun. The light off its scales hurts to look at. Move.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
The cistern is dry. Haul from a creek (risky water), or put someone on water duty.
💬 Aki says: "That Vex Marlowe... I don't like the way it looks at you. Be careful."
💧 Aki returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 Hermann returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 Ingrid returns with water: +2 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

💛 You hold Dog tags. Not yours. Niamh's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Niamh would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Travel 1 tile to meadow.
The Sunback stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Rubble chokes the path.
Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
One down — but 2 still hold the treeline. The gorge goes on.
Something moves out there — The Eulogy.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 11× Blackberry (715 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
While you were gone — 2 things you missed:
⚔️ Ingrid stood down the Living Wire and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Ingrid stared down the Sunback and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
You keep a day's food (715 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 68 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
📋 Ingrid — 🍲 Cook. They'll report back by next part.
Ines speaks only 🇧🇷 Portuguese. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
🍲 Ingrid cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
🥣 Lucia of Emberhold walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."

🌙 Night. The lingering Sunback gorges at the treeline — 1,200 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,662 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2463 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Ines laugh — a real one.
Ingrid traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Ingrid traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Hermann and Ines lingered over the fire together.
📓 Codex: Aki taught Hermann Animal Behavior.
🤒 Ines is sitting up again. Whatever the fever was, it let go.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1200 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌙 Raid — Ashford came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1100 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU! — your showbiz fans"
Inside: Investigator's Coat
Plus 45 kcal of fan-approved snacks.
💬 Ines says: "The voice said 'north.' Just... north. I don't know what it means."
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
🌱 Ingrid works the garden — watered, weeded, turned. Nothing ripe yet.
👥 Hermann heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
👥 Aki walks out with Hermann. "Nobody walks alone today."
Ingrid heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
Ines is over the cookpot, blowing on a spoonful before it goes back in.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 1L left.
No risky water to boil.

🚶 Aki is back with Hermann.
💧 Hermann returns with water: +3 clean.
🌾 Nothing comes from Emberhold this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +1,688 kcal, trust -2.)
🌾 Nothing comes from Ashford this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +1,688 kcal, trust -2.)
🧳 Word from Emberhold: traders say Emberhold had a new speaker — or so the traders say

◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

🌙 Night. The lingering Sunback gorges at the treeline — 1,120 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,100 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
Ants march past your boot, laden. You follow them to a seep. +1L water (risky). (ant_trail)
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2690 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Aki laugh — a real one.
Debora came back with 381 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Hermann and Aki lingered over the fire together.
📓 Codex: Aki taught Ingrid Reading Tracks.
🤒 Hermann is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.

🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 162 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Wild Strawberry; Blackberry went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
🥣 Aisha of Emberhold stands at your fire, thinner than pride allows. "Emberhold is eating bark. We're asking — 1,338 kcal, whatever you can spare. We'll remember it."
(They beg — give from the beats row, or refuse aloud. If they once fed you, refusing costs double.)
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
It arches its back to the sun. The light off its scales hurts to look at. Move.
Boiled 1L. Bacteria dead. (-35 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
Drank clean water.
🦕 It moves.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ SUNBACK! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
Aki heads out to forage. "Out for a forage. If I'm late, start without me."
Ines heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
AMBUSH: first blood. ×1.5.
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
You STRIKE the Sunback for 30 (Sharpened stick).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
Sunback is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Sunback for 26 (Sharpened stick).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 Tail Sweep!
Armor absorbs 9.
Sunback's Tail Sweep hits you for 7.
📖 Codex: Tail Sweep — strikes a nearby square — step aside during the windup. You won't forget this.
OVERCHARGED ×1.25 (well-fed): food is fuel.
The Sunback falls.
You STRIKE the Sunback for 23 (Sharpened stick).
📺 +5 style — solid hit
📺 +20 style — dropped the Sunback!

Tough reptile meat — stew it long. The mirror-scales flake off; they're pretty and useless. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
📯 It moves.
Its posture changes. Curiosity is over.
🌱 Ingrid works the garden — watered, weeded, turned. Nothing ripe yet.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Ingrid — Field 1. Three offers; they took Lucky Rock. Earned, chosen. (lucky_rock: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Ingrid chose Lucky Rock (lucky_rock) at Field 1.
